# Retap Media

> Retap Media LLC (Florida) builds the systems that help businesses respond,
> book, and follow up: conversion websites, forms and CRM integration,
> booking and follow-up automation, AI answering, database reactivation, and
> under-60-second speed-to-lead response. Clients can take the integrated
> system or hire Retap for a single focused build. Retap does not sell lead
> generation; it improves the demand pathways a business already has.
> Everything plugs into the client's existing CRM; no new ad spend required.

Founded by Preston Whitty (sales and scoping) and Patrick Viau (systems and
delivery); a small sales and support team handles inquiries. Appointment
playbooks are built for home-services trades; websites, CRM integration,
booking, and AI answering are available to any business that takes inquiries.
Appointments are counted as qualified sits (reconfirmed, transcript attached;
no-shows replaced, not tallied), and response time, qualification, times
offered, bookings, sits, and revenue are reported as separate numbers.
Compliance model: carrier-registered numbers in the client's name, first-party
lists only, instant opt-out honoring, business-hours sending, client-owned
consent and message logs.

Onboarding takes about two weeks (credentials and requirements, numbers and
integrations, script approval, testing, confirmed launch date). Texting
activates when carrier registration is approved; that timing is not
guaranteed.

## Ways to get started

- Book a demo (30 minutes with Preston; booking a demo does not purchase
  anything): https://book.retapmedia.com/
- Tell us what you need (inquiry form, no time slot required, reply by
  email): https://retapmedia.com/inquiry.html
- Free response-time audit, also called the Ghost Test (Retap submits a
  real-looking inquiry through the business's website, timestamps every
  response, and emails results within 48 hours; no sales call required):
  https://retapmedia.com/inquiry.html?intent=audit
